control: Apply only the same median rate and horizon to the frozen baseline
description: Apply a spatially varying apparent thinning rate, shrunk toward the robust global rate, to the frozen S1 joint_blend baseline
training: Historical eligible pairs 2018 to 2022. Leave the entire scored simple section out of rate estimation. Use only direct eligible prior minima as input for the spatial term, with median-only rate on fallback rows. Signed historical apparent rates are used; output is clipped to the existing thickness bounds.
